## Safety checklist
- [ ] Synthetic data only. No real names, emails, campaign exports, or instance details.
- [ ] No new network, mail, or process-spawning imports in `agents/` or `app/`.
- [ ] If a check's logic changed: `docs/checks.md` and `app/demo.js` updated (CI demo-parity test passes).
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated.
- [ ] Known limits in the README are still accurate.
